column1: # ghidra_names_bank0.tsv - JXC 4K monitor firmware, bank 0 (common code, flash 0x00000-0x0FFFF), 8051:BE:16:default

column4: Called from the VCP 0xCA case (bank 5) with DD29 (value low byte). Purpose unconfirmed.
Key event index from bank6 key_post_event (0..4); OSD handlers switch on it.

Power-on splash sequence: FUN_CODE_0cc3(1), 0585(0x12,7,0xd0), LCALL 0x0FAB (bank1 splash builder 0x8ECC), 0e25(100)+0de9(100) delays (hold logo), 0f9f(2), d9df. Only invoker of the bank1 glyph builder. docs/boot-logo.md.
OSD screen/menu dispatcher: R7->DBAD (screen id), E057 (input source) checks, LCALL 0x0FC9 (fontdl_orient) + 0x0FDB (bank2 menu builder 0xF049). Menu/source screens, not the boot splash.
Banked trampoline: DPTR=0x8ECC (bank1 splash builder) + LJMP 0x043B. Called from d986 only.
Banked trampoline: DPTR=0xF049 (bank2 menu/source builder) + LJMP 0x044D. Called from ~8 bank0 dispatch states.
Switch on e151: 1->ee33(1), 2->ee33(3), 3->fcfe, 6->c3ea. Sibling copies at fda8,fdc9,fdea,fe0b.
Switch on e151: 1/2 adjust value; 3/6 fcfe+0dc5, e150=0x10.
Switch on e151: 1/2 value change; 3/6 fcfe.
PWM frequency: R7=0x10 selects PWM4, R4:R5 freq param; FF3A/FF3C/FF43/FF44/FF49 (issue #7).
